config.changed_synergy.title: Changed: Synergy Settings
config.changed_synergy.defaults_applied: This page has been reset to its defaults.
config.changed_synergy.invalid_value: One or more values are invalid or outside their allowed range.
config.changed_synergy.server_note: In multiplayer, Gameplay & AI settings are controlled by the server.
config.changed_synergy.option.respect_pa: Unarmed latex creatures with Changed Addon Plus's Pacified effect will not chase or attack players.
config.changed_synergy.option.pacify_pet: Continuously refresh Pacified on native Changed pets so they do not lock onto targets by mistake. Requires Changed Addon Plus.
config.changed_synergy.option.pet_regene: Regeneration level for native Changed pets. Zero disables it.
config.changed_synergy.option.awareness_: Maximum distance used when evaluating nearby players and creature relationships.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_int: Polite individuals may greet unfamiliar humans before deciding whether to hunt.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_ran: Maximum distance at which a polite individual begins a cautious greeting.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_spe: Navigation speed used while approaching a human politely.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_wai: Seconds a polite individual waits for the human to respond with a pat.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_att: Unanswered greetings before the individual returns to its usual attitude.
config.changed_synergy.option.visual_ran: Base distance for first noticing a player. Line of sight and field of view still apply.
config.changed_synergy.option.pursuit_ra: Base distance at which a creature keeps pursuing a confirmed target.
config.changed_synergy.option.lose_sight: Seconds without line of sight before a pursuer searches the last sighting.
config.changed_synergy.option.search_tim: Seconds spent investigating the last seen or heard player position.
config.changed_synergy.option.alert_radi: Distance over which compatible nearby creatures share a confirmed sighting.
config.changed_synergy.option.search_spe: Navigation speed used only while investigating or searching.
config.changed_synergy.option.gunshot_ra: Used by firearm integrations without their own sound range. TACZ supplies its own value.
config.changed_synergy.option.firearm_ev: Hostile creatures may move laterally while pursuing an armed player.
config.changed_synergy.option.grab_chanc: Chance that an eligible hostile grab starts its escape QTE.
config.changed_synergy.option.organic_gr: Separate grab chance for organic creatures, whose assimilation relies on physical grabs.
config.changed_synergy.option.mindless_m: Let latex creatures fully transfur mindless mobs such as zombies and skeletons. Disabled by default so they are absorbed instead, reducing the number of persistent entities created.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_r: Maximum distance at which a player can receive creature dialogue.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_c: Minimum seconds between messages from the same speaker to the same listener.
Chance that an eligible state change produces a line.
config.changed_synergy.option.personalit: Chance that a suitable cue uses the individual's dominant-trait line.
config.changed_synergy.option.translator: Using Changed Addon Plus's Translator item bypasses the permanent telepathy unlock requirement.
config.changed_synergy.option.telepathy_: Standard completed transfurs needed to understand telepathic speech permanently.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_scr: Optional: show the theme-coloured transfur mask that grows inward with progress. Leave this off to keep Changed's current display.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_ski: Optional: show staged latex coating on partially transfurred skins and first-person arms. Leave this off to keep Changed's current display.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_opa: Maximum opacity of the transfur progress screen effect.
config.changed_synergy.option.suit_vigne: Show a soft theme-coloured edge effect while wrapped by a pet or bonded creature.
config.changed_synergy.option.suit_opaci: Opacity of the friendly wrapping edge effect.
config.changed_synergy.option.danmaku.de: Show ordinary creature dialogue in the screen overlay. Disable it to use chat instead.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_d: Choose random popups or horizontal danmaku. Auto uses popups for English and danmaku for CJK languages.
config.changed_synergy.option.territory_: Show biome entry subtitles and persistent information for facility areas.
config.changed_synergy.option.mechanic_h: Show one-time hints for Synergy's important interactions.
config.changed_synergy.option.qte_animat: Enable animated grab and hypnosis QTE presentation.
config.changed_synergy.option.reduced_mo: Keep fades and input feedback while removing shake, drift, and large scaling motion.
advancement.changed_synergy.root.title: Changed: Synergy
advancement.changed_synergy.root.descrip: Get to know the latex creatures sharing your world.
advancement.changed_synergy.first_contac: Get acquainted with a latex creature.
advancement.changed_synergy.trusted_frie: Build enough familiarity to call a creature your friend.
advancement.changed_synergy.close_compan: Become close friends with a latex creature.
advancement.changed_synergy.shared_momen: Spend some time playing with a creature you know.
advancement.changed_synergy.peace_offeri: Stop a pursuit with a well-timed pat.
advancement.changed_synergy.bonded_compa: Form your first exclusive bond with a latex creature.
advancement.changed_synergy.protected_by: Have your bonded partner reach and wrap you before it is too late.
advancement.changed_synergy.hypnosis_esc: Break free from a creature's hypnosis.
advancement.changed_synergy.telepathy.de: Learn to understand latex telepathy without a translator.
advancement.changed_synergy.faction_ally: Earn allied standing with any faction.
advancement.changed_synergy.white_hive_c: As original white latex, be defended by the nearby white consensus.
advancement.changed_synergy.white_factio: Earn the white latex group's respect. Its pillars, blocks, and troublesome latex puddles can no longer inflict transfur damage on you.
advancement.changed_synergy.dark_faction: Earn the dark latex group's respect. Its latex crystals, wolf crystals, and dark puddles can no longer inflict transfur damage on you.
advancement.changed_synergy.light_factio: Earn the respect of any one Light Latex group.
advancement.changed_synergy.white_factio: Become allied with the white latex group. Nearby white latex will treat whoever attacks you as a common enemy.
advancement.changed_synergy.dark_faction: Become allied with the dark latex group. Nearby dark latex will treat whoever attacks you as a common enemy.
advancement.changed_synergy.aquatic_fact: Become allied with the aquatic group. Nearby aquatic latex will treat whoever attacks you as a common enemy.
advancement.changed_synergy.light_factio: Become allied with one Light Latex group. Nearby members will treat whoever attacks you as a common enemy.
advancement.changed_synergy.all_factions: Become allied with the white, dark, and aquatic groups, plus any one Light Latex group.
advancement.changed_synergy.mysterious_f: Open an outpost barrel before the guards trust you with it.
message.changed_synergy.telepathy.unlock: The distant voices settle into words. You can now understand the telepathic network.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_tran: Wait. That change is about to take hold. Come here, I will cover you.
Do not force yourself through it. Let me draw the remaining change back down.
There, it backed off. Come out and try a few steps.
We caught it in time. Call me a little sooner next time, all right?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_trans: You cannot hold it back much longer. Come here, I have you!
One more hit will finish it. Come close and let me handle the rest.
Forced it back. Good, it did not get to claim this round.
It backed down. Stay close until your feet are steady.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_tr: The change is rising too fast. Follow my voice and come close.
Do not let it pull you under. I can shelter you until it recedes.
It is receding now. Take your time before you move away.
The pressure has eased. You are yourself again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_tran: Do not let that change get there first! Come here, I will cover you.
Your scent is almost buried. Get close before I lose it.
There you are. I knew your own scent was still underneath.
It backed off. Good, keep close for another moment.
overlay.changed_synergy.hypnosis.title: Stay focused
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.hypno_: Look into my eyes. Yes, just like that. Breathe slowly.
Don't hurry away. Stay with me and it'll get quiet soon.
Awake already? All right, take a moment.
You slipped out. I'll go a little slower next time.
I found your rhythm. Don't worry, I'll be gentle.
Tired? Stay still and let me come closer.
Hey, it was so quiet a second ago.
Who woke you up? I'm still right here.
Hey, my rhythm! You knocked it right out of place.
Hey, you were supposed to look in my eyes! Why the pat?
You came over just to pat me? I like that plan better.
This is nicer than making you stare. One more, then.
There you are. New paws, same bright eyes. Come on, try a step.
Welcome. Give your ears a twitch and hear what's changed.
Want to test your focus? Keep your eyes on mine.
A little staring game. Try not to drift off, all right?
You held on! Hm, you're sharper than you look.
There you are. You slipped past the rhythm fair and square.
Got you. Don't worry, it was only a game.
Your eyes went soft for a moment. That counts as my win.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.lumina: Watch the light in my eyes. Let's see how long you can follow it.
Ready? Hold my gaze and don't lose the rhythm.
Nicely done. You kept your thoughts steady.
You broke the pattern. I didn't expect that so quickly.
Easy now. I caught your attention, that's all.
That little pause gave you away. My round.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.kayla_: Follow the sway. Let's see if your focus can keep up.
Eyes here. Try not to drift with the current.
You stayed on course. Not bad at all.
You shook it off. Quick thinking.
Caught in the current. Just for a second.
There, you drifted. That round is mine.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.experi: Focus on me. Let's measure how steady you are.
Keep your attention here. No tricks beyond the rhythm.
A clean resistance. I'll remember that.
Your focus slipped. The test is over.
I have your rhythm. Relax, this was practice.
Look here. I want to try something with your focus.
Hold still and follow the pattern. Ready?
You got out. That was faster than expected.
Pattern broken. You win this one.
There it is. Your focus wandered.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.generi: Keep your eyes here. Let's test your focus.
Ready? Follow the rhythm and try to resist.
You held your focus. Your round.
Caught you. It was only a game.
Your focus slipped for a moment. My round.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.gunshot_h: So loud! That lump of iron bites. Everyone, keep back!
My head is still ringing... spread out, and do not let it roar again.
That thing went off and scrambled every thought. Stop them first!
That noisy iron thing again! Do not let it frighten everyone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.gunshot_f: Oh! You startled me. How can that little thing be so loud?
My head is still humming... warn us next time, please?
So that thing in your hand makes that sound? Everyone jumped.
I know you did not mean it for us, but it is terribly loud.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.gunshot_ho: Gah! That thing bites! Take them down!
My head is still ringing. Together now, before they use it again!
There it goes again! Forget the iron thing. Pin down whoever holds it.
That thing threw the whole group off. Get close and make it stop.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.gunshot_fr: Ow... that iron lump of yours is loud. Warn me next time.
You nearly deafened me. Does that thing have to shout?
Well, the whole group heard that. Lower the thing for a moment.
I know it was not meant for me, but that noise is ridiculous.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.gunshot: Gah, my ears! Drop that thing!
It roared again... now I only want to knock it out of your hand.
That sound rattled my head. Enough. Throw it away!
I dislike metal that roars. I dislike you hurting others with it more.
Ah! Don't scare me like that! Why is it so loud?!
The metal and burnt smell is stronger now... keep it away for a moment.
My head still hurts. Does that thing sound like this every time?
I know you meant no harm. When it speaks, my whole body tenses.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.gunshot: That noise shook the water! Make the iron thing stop!
Even the surface jumped. Do not let them set it off again!
Again! The echo is everywhere underwater. Catch them first!
That iron lump scared every fish away. Do not let it roar again.
Ah! That sounds terrifying... What is that thing?
My head is still humming. Try it farther from the water next time, please?
I know you did not point it at me, but the water carried every bit of it.
Lower that noisy iron thing. We hear it far too clearly down here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.gunshot_h: What a roar! Disarm them, quick!
That noise made everything go numb. Do not let that iron beast shout again!
That huge noise again! Pin them before they touch it!
That lump of iron roars louder than anything. Enough, take it away!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.gunshot_f: Hey! I nearly jumped. Why is that thing in your hand so loud?
I am still tense. Warn me before it shouts next time.
So that iron thing can roar? That was a nasty surprise.
I know it was not for me, but the noise made every muscle tense.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.firearm_n: What is that hard thing in your hand? Everyone is trying to guess.
It doesn't look like food or a tool. Can I have a look?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.firearm_no: What's with the toy? Put it down.
That thing looks strange... Let me see it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.firearm: Uh... That thing in your hand smells of metal and oil. What does it do?
That hard thing has no heartbeat. Why do you keep holding it?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.firearm: Does that metal thing mind water? I want to touch it.
What are you holding? It does not look like it can swim.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.firearm_n: What is that iron thing in your hand? Is it fun, or does it bite?
You keep guarding that thing. Let me look.
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcAI.description: Enables improved investigation, coordinated pursuit, underwater pursuit, and related pathfinding.
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcDialogue.descr: Allows creatures to send nearby players contextual lines during social interactions and AI state changes.
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcEmotes.descrip: Allows creatures to display the same emotion bubbles used by the /emote command.
gamerule.changedSynergyFactionReputation: Enables faction standing gains, losses and their gameplay benefits.
gamerule.changedSynergyBondSystem.descri: Enables bonds, bonded following, protection, wrapping, rescue and companion controls.
Enables familiarity, lasting friendships, friend following and combat assistance.
Shows territory and facility context on the HUD. World generation and biome spawning are not changed.
gamerule.changedSynergyPersonalitySystem: Lets stable individual traits affect AI, tolerance, social habits and dialogue selection.
gamerule.changedSynergyCreatureLife.desc: Enables persistence for related creatures, role-driven activities, community memory, gathering, outposts and pure-white reformation. Disabling it pauses these systems without deleting their records.
gamerule.changedSynergyHypnosisQte.descr: Enables Synergy's hypnosis escape sequence, control lock and mesmerized penalty. Changed's base hypnosis remains when disabled.
gamerule.changedSynergyGrabQteEnhancemen: Enables server-synced grab prompts and the safety stun after escape. Changed's base grab remains when disabled, and creatures can attack again immediately after an escape.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: Wait... That's a real human! Everyone, stop crowding. Let me see!
A human! It's been so long. Slow down, we have so much to ask you!
Don't run. We don't want to hurt you. Everyone around here has simply noticed you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_t: Oh, a new face. Relax. Keep things friendly and so will we.
Someone new. Don't crowd them. If they mean no harm, neither do we.
Never seen that form before. That's all right. Let's keep things friendly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.alert_hum: It really is a human! Go around slowly, don't scare them!
Don't crowd in! I know everyone wants a look. Leave them a way through.
Someone meet them up ahead! Take it easy, we've waited so long for this!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.alert_tra: Spread out a little. Don't lose them!
They changed direction. Someone meet them up ahead.
Work out what kind they are before we close in.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.heard_hum: Wait. Those are human footsteps... a real human?
Quiet, everyone. I think I hear a sound we haven't heard in years.
There's a human over there. Go slowly before they vanish again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.heard_tra: That doesn't sound human. A transfurred one is nearby.
Unfamiliar sound. Stay close enough to help each other.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.lost_huma: They're gone? They were right here... everyone stop and listen.
Don't scatter. We finally met a human; don't scare them farther away.
They're hiding. Be quiet. Maybe they'll come out again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.lost_tran: Their trail blends into the others. Stop and listen.
Lost sight of the transfurred one. Don't rush after them.
They hide well. Stay where we can help each other.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.reacquire: There! Easy now, don't send them running again.
Oh good, you're still here! Let's take it a little slower this time.
There you are! Everyone looked so sad when you disappeared.
Found you. That form still stands out.
There you are again. Don't start a fight yet.
You're here. Maybe you're ready to explain yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.give_up_h: Aww, they're really gone... Come on, let's go tell the others!
Stop chasing. At least now we know humans are still out there.
Let them go. Next time, no one rushes in all at once.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.give_up_t: No point chasing that far. Let's go back.
Leave it here. We can ask questions next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: Hold. A real human. Pass the word back and keep the front clear.
A human... finally, a real one. Steady. Let me speak first.
Human! Hold your places. The pack has an order, so use it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_tr: An outsider. The rule here is simple: don't start anything and neither will we.
Seen. Not one of ours, but if you're friendly, we're fine.
New face. This is our ground. Don't cause trouble and we won't give you any.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.alert_huma: Spread out. Front rank, easy. Nobody scares this one away.
Catch them ahead, but no hard hits. The Alpha wants them alive.
Steady! If you want a closer look, wait your turn.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.alert_tran: Close from both sides. Do it, and hold your place.
Block the exits and identify the form. No rushing without the signal.
Shift over. We move link by link, so do not let them split us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.heard_huma: Stop. Those steps aren't from an outsider... They're human. Pass the word back.
Quiet. I hear a human. Front confirms, the rest wait for the signal.
Human footsteps ahead! Stay close, and don't all pile in at once.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.heard_tran: Those aren't human footsteps. Someone's transfurred nearby.
Those aren't human steps. Watch the sides.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.lost_human: They're gone. Nobody scatter! Chances like this are rare.
They slipped us. Search again, quietly.
Hold the exits. I want to know where this human came from.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.lost_trans: They're out of sight. Don't let the chase split us up.
Hold here and wait for them to show.
Trail ends here. Check the area again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.reacquired: Found them. Everyone pull back; don't drive them off again.
There you are. You threw the whole group off for a moment.
Human here. Good... I'll go in myself this time.
Got eyes on them again. Close both sides.
There you are. You move well, I'll give you that.
They're here. Don't let them split the group.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.give_up_hu: Break off. Send word back that we saw a human.
Fall back. At least we can tell the Alpha that humans really are still out here.
Let them go this time. We cannot lose them again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.give_up_tr: Break off. We don't know enough to push farther.
Fall back. We'll deal with it next time.
That's far enough. Don't follow them beyond our ground.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.spotted: Wait... that scent. Human. A real human.
Heartbeat, breath, body heat... It all fits. A real human.
Don't run. I won't make the first move. I never expected to meet you here.
New scent. Haven't met you before, but we won't have a problem if you're friendly.
An outsider... If you mean no harm, I won't trouble you.
Never seen your kind before. Relax. I'm only learning how you move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.alert_h: They're attacking! Don't hurt them too badly, just make them stop!
Go around the front. I still want to know why they attacked.
Pin them down, but be careful! We can't let them get hurt.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.alert_t: They're quick. Don't lunge from the front.
Go around. Come in from the side.
Get a clear scent before you move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.heard_h: Wait. Those are human steps... No doubt about it.
Soft steps, but the scent is unmistakable. A real human is nearby.
Everyone stop. I hear a sound I haven't heard in a long time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.heard_t: Listen to those steps. An outsider is nearby.
Steady breathing. They haven't gone far.
An unfamiliar scent is moving. Follow, but don't crowd it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.lost_hu: The scent faded... but they were definitely here.
Don't chase blindly. Frightened humans hide. Wait.
The breathing stopped. Remember that scent; don't lose it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.lost_tr: The scent changed. They may be circling us.
They're gone. Don't chase every false sound.
Tracks stop here. Wait for them to move again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.reacqui: There's that scent again. Oh good, you haven't vanished.
There. Your heartbeat led me back.
Found you. I'll keep my distance this time. Don't run.
There it is. Your scent is easy to remember.
Found you again. Let's see how you respond.
Over there. A different form won't hide your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.give_up: The scent is fading. At least I know humans are alive.
Stop chasing. If we press them too hard, we'll learn nothing.
Let them go. Next time I'll make it clear I mean no harm.
No need to chase them elsewhere. Go back.
Remember that scent. We can talk next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.spotted: Wait, up on shore... is that a human? Really?
A human! Slow down, please! Don't leave yet!
A real person on the shore! Stop splashing, I want to see!
Someone new by the water... Can you swim? Keep it friendly and we can play.
I haven't seen anyone move like that. No problem, just don't cause trouble by the water.
I see you. Relax. Keep things friendly and so will we.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.alert_h: Hold the shallows. Don't scare them into deep water.
Move around both sides. Humans don't come often; don't make a mess of this.
They're heading ashore. Meet them ahead, gently!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.alert_t: They know how to use the water. Spread out and don't collide.
Hold the channel. I'll circle underneath.
They're heading for dry ground. Leave one by the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.heard_h: That water sounds wrong... human footsteps.
A real human was by the shore. The ripples are fresh.
Quiet. I hear footsteps I haven't heard in years.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.heard_t: Light water movement. That's someone transfurred.
That splash wasn't made by one of ours.
The current was disturbed. They're nearby.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.lost_hu: The water's still... but I know I saw a human.
The tracks stop here. Search the bank slowly; don't drive them away.
Lost them. Everyone wait. They may come back to the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.lost_tr: The ripples stop here. They know how to hide.
Lost them. Don't chase blindly through cloudy water.
No tracks on shore. Get back in and listen.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.reacqui: There you are! Slow down, I wasn't finished looking at you!
There you are! You have no idea how busy the water got.
Found you! I don't mean to scare you, I just didn't want to lose you again!
Found you. Water gives away your movement.
There you are again. You know how to use the water too.
Over there. Don't churn up this water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.give_up: They're too far... back to the water. We have news to tell.
Stop chasing. At least a human really came to the water today.
Let them go. Next time, nobody splashes them the moment we meet.
They've left the water. Don't follow.
Head back. A stranger isn't worth leaving the water for.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_h: Wait, a human? A real human!
That scent... I thought I'd never smell it again. Don't run off!
Human over here! Back off, I found them first!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_t: An outsider. You look quick. Want to play if you're friendly?
Haven't seen you before. Don't start trouble and we'll get along.
New scent. That's all right. Let's start with hello.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.alert_hum: Go around! Don't pounce too hard; we finally found one.
They went that way. Move, but don't pile into each other!
I'm going ahead! Anyone who scares them off answers to me!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.alert_tra: They're quick. Don't chase in a straight line.
Circle both sides and leave no opening for a counterattack.
I'll drive them forward. Watch the path ahead.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.heard_hum: Stop! Human footsteps, not a transfurred one.
I smell it... a human scent that hasn't passed this way in ages.
There's a real human over there. Easy. Don't scare them off before we get close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.heard_tra: Listen to those steps... An outsider is nearby.
Unfamiliar scent over there. Go take a look.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.lost_huma: Gone? That scent was real a moment ago.
Stop charging around! Smell the air. We don't get chances like this.
They actually hid from me... not bad. But I still want to say hi!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.lost_tran: The scent stops here. They hide well.
Gone from sight. Stop and listen.
They shook me? This one's good.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.reacquire: Found you! Don't vanish the moment I blink this time.
There you are. You had everyone sniffing around the same circle.
Hey again, human! Can I finally get a good look at you?
Found you again. Now let's see who's faster.
There you are. That's a clever hiding trick.
I see you. Easy now, the chase is only starting again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.give_up_h: Too far. Fine. At least the scent was real.
That's enough chasing. Next time, I'm speaking first.
You win this round. Let's go tell the others there are humans out here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.give_up_t: That's enough today. We can race again.
No fun chasing beyond our ground. Head back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.success_a: All done. Look at yourself. Can you feel it? We're all right here with you.
Welcome. Try moving around a little before you run off.
It worked! Everyone will recognize you soon.
Hold steady. We can travel more easily together.
No more chasing. You are right here with me.
Rest for a moment. I will carry us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_ally: You are here too. Walk with me for a while.
Good timing. Could you watch the other side?
Hello. No need to stand so far away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_riva: Stop there. Something about you feels wrong.
Do not come closer. We are not moving aside.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_outs: Oh, a new face. Relax. Keep things friendly and so will we.
You're not one of our kind, but that's all right. If you mean no harm, neither do we.
First time meeting, right? Relax. We can get to know each other slowly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.ally_fall: Someone is down. Hurry, check on them!
Do not leave our friend there. Come with me.
You hurt one of us. That is not a game.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.success_as: Welcome to the pack. Get to know the others.
Not bad. Our newest member looks sharp.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.success_ab: Got you. We travel together from here.
Chase over. Your strength is not going to waste.
Good timing. Help me hold this side.
Taking over? Great, I could use a breather.
One of ours. Come lend a hand.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_rival: Hostile. Hold your ground and give them no opening.
Stop there. One more step and we fight.
Looks like this comes first today.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_outsi: Haven't seen you before. This is our ground. Don't cause trouble and there won't be any.
Passing through is fine. Keep it friendly and we'll each go our own way.
You're not one of ours, but that's fine. Don't swing first and neither will we.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.ally_falle: One of us is down. Two with me, now!
Keep calm. Secure the area first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.success: There. Catch your breath, then try a few steps.
Try standing. Your body already knows what to do.
Good. Now you can keep up with us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_al: Familiar scent. Come patrol with me.
You are nearby too? Good, walk with me.
One of ours. Stay close so I can keep track of you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ri: That scent is hostile. Stay where you are.
Do not come closer. We protect our territory.
A rival is here. Be ready to hold them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ou: New scent... First time we've met, right? Let's keep it friendly.
You can stay. If you mean no harm, I won't trouble you.
I haven't met you before. Relax. I'm only learning your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.ally_fa: Our friend is down. Hurry, move!
Their breathing stopped... keep the enemy away.
Remember who did this. We cannot be careless again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.success: All done. Try the water, then try the land.
Welcome. Take your time. You'll get used to it soon.
It worked! Now you can keep up with us in the water.
Got you. Stay quiet in there and I'll take us swimming.
No more chase. We are joined now.
Do not panic. Follow my breathing for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_al: You too? Race me to the far side.
Good timing. Let's watch this stretch of water together.
A familiar face. Come stay awhile.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ri: This water does not welcome you. Stop.
A hostile visitor. Keep them away.
Back off. Stir things up again and we fight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ou: Haven't seen you before. Swimmer or not, just keep it friendly.
There's room for a new face by the shore. Don't cause trouble and we'll get along.
A new visitor? Welcome. Just keep things friendly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.ally_fa: Do not leave them there alone.
Who hurt them? Watch the area.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.success_a: Got you! Look at that new form. It suits you.
All changed. Get up and try running around.
Welcome over. You'll get used to it quickly.
I won that chase. Let's go together from here.
Quiet. I will carry you out of here.
Don't worry. Your part is still here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_ally: Good timing. Want to run together?
Familiar face. Found anything fun lately?
You are here too. Saves me wandering alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_riva: This ground does not welcome you. Find another path.
Do not come closer. I am not giving way today.
Hostile scent. Looks like we fight first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_outs: New face. Lost? That's fine. Just be friendly.
Passing through is fine. Don't start trouble and neither will we.
Haven't seen you before. Come say hello. No need to worry.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.ally_fall: One of us is down. Follow me!
Who did it? This is not over.
Stop staring and watch the area.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_welc: I brought you in myself. From now on, you're one of us!
Welcome. You are my partner, and the others will look after you too.
Well, we truly cannot be separated now.
Do not worry. I will carry your part of us with care.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_bonde: Yes, just like that. You remembered what I like.
One touch from you, and all that irritation is gone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_kin.0: Of course our own kind knows how. One more?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_kin.1: All right, I will gladly take that.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_frien: So that is how your kind says hello. It feels nice.
Sure, you can keep going for a little while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_outsi: Is that a peace offering? All right, we'll both step back.
Unfamiliar touch, but no harm in it. I won't chase for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_human: You really came that close? All right, I'll stop chasing.
Human hands are warmer than I expected. You can stay a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_rival: Move your hand away. We are not that close.
Do not test me this way. I am still watching you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: My turn. Hold still and let me care for you too.
You always do this for me. I should return it.
Come here. Our own kind should greet each other properly.
Stand closer. I want to see how you have been.
Do not worry, just one touch. I am curious about you.
Does your kind accept this greeting? Let me try.
We had just stopped. So that touch was only meant to lower our guard.
You asked us to trust you, then struck as soon as we did. We will remember that.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_truce: Please move your hand. Last time we stopped, you hit us at once.
Do not try that again. We all remember what followed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_welco: I brought you in. From now on, we move side by side.
Welcome aboard. Stay with me, and I will watch your back.
Chase over. We move as one now.
You will not be left behind. I am taking you all the way.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_bonded: That is not permission to slack off... one more is fine.
Good technique. Five seconds of rest, then we move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_kin.1: Good. Start with that next time we meet.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_friend: Our allies know this trick too? I am impressed.
All right. I can lower my guard for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_outsid: Touching me without warning was a risk. You didn't attack, so let it go.
A peace offering? Understood. We'll stop here.
You touched the one chasing you? Bold. Fine, we pause.
Trying to distract me? It worked. I won't chase yet.
Hand away. The sides have not changed.
Drop the act. I am not falling for it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Do not spend it all on me. Come here, my turn.
Fair is fair. Hold still.
One of ours. Come say hello properly.
Let me see whether you have been getting lazy.
Relax, it is only one touch.
Your people do not greet each other this way? Learn something new.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.betrayed.0: So that was the trick. You got me to stop, then took your free hit.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.betrayed.1: If you want a fight, say so. Do not hide the first swing behind a pat.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_truce_: Hand back. Last time I stopped, you attacked.
You already used that trick once. I am not giving you another opening.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_we: I changed you myself. I will help you adjust.
Welcome. Learn my scent, and stay with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_bon: One touch, and I know it is you.
Yes, keep going. My breathing is already slower.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_kin: This is how our own kind feels nearby. Natural.
A familiar touch. You can do that again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_fri: I accept the greeting. I will stop chasing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_out: Warm hand. All right, we can be peaceful.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_hum: Still afraid, and you reached out anyway.
A human hand is warm. I'll stop chasing for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_riv: Do not touch me. Your scent keeps me alert.
Move your hand. There is no trust between us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Come here. Let me hear that you are all right.
Do not dodge. Let me touch your forehead.
Same kind, come close.
Come closer. Let me hear you breathe. Mm, you sound well.
Hold still. This is a simple greeting.
Your body heat is unfamiliar. Do not be afraid.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.betraye: So that touch was meant to make me relax. I know your scent now.
Your hand was gentle one moment and hurt me the next. Stay back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_tru: Do not touch me. When you reach out, I remember the strike first.
Move your hand. Your touch will not make me relax again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_we: I helped you become this. Swim with me from now on.
Welcome, partner. Water or land, I will stay nearby.
We really are inseparable now. I will remember you.
The chase is over. I carry both of us from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_bon: Yes, that pressure is just right. Again?
One touch from you, and even the water feels calmer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_kin: Our kind knows how to say hello.
That feels good. Do the same next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_fri: A greeting from another water? Not bad.
All right, I accept. Rest with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_out: Making peace this way? Fine, I won't chase.
Steady hand. All right, you mean no harm.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_hum: A human came to the water on purpose? That's rare.
Trading that for a breather? Fine, take a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_riv: Do not touch me. This is not a peace meeting.
Move your hand. I am still watching you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: You always greet me first. Come here, my turn.
Stand closer. I owe you one.
One of mine, do not dodge.
Come here. I want to see how you have been swimming.
You look unusual. May I touch?
Relax. A waterfolk greeting is gentle.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.betraye: The water had barely settled when you struck. That was no peace offering.
I really did stop when you touched me. I will not make that mistake twice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_tru: Do not touch me. Last time the water settled, you attacked.
Move your hand. I will not give you another chance to catch your breath.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_welc: I changed you myself. Stay close from now on.
Welcome, partner. Half my road is yours.
The chase is over. We watch the road together now.
You are right here. I will not forget you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_bonde: Right pressure. You know me well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_kin.0: Our kind keeps a greeting simple.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_kin.1: Not bad. You can do that again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_frien: Good technique for an outsider. I will remember it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_outsi: Hm? Is that how you say hello? You know the rules.
Takes nerve to reach out. Fine, go your way.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_human: You really came close. Fine, catch your breath.
One touch for a chance to breathe? Good timing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_rival: Do not touch me. We are still opposed.
That will not distract me. Step back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Come here. I get to care for you sometimes too.
Hold still, I owe you a greeting.
One of mine, come closer.
Let me make sure you have not gone slow.
Do not move, just one touch.
I have never seen your kind. Come here.
So that pat was meant to make me relax. Fine, I remember you now.
If you want a fight, start one. Do not use a pat as cover.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_truce: Do not try that again. I trusted you once and got hit for it.
Hand back. I already fell for that once.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: Come here. Just a quick hello.
Do not move away. I only want to give you a pat.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.attacked_: The enemy struck first. Everyone, come closer!
So much for talking. We will stop you here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: We greet our allies before we work. Come here.
Do not dodge. Friends look after each other.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.attacked_b: The enemy struck first. Take position, do not rush.
Good, they came to us. Watch your side.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: You mean no harm. Come here, I will answer in kind.
Do not worry. One gentle touch.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.attacke: Hostile scent, moving in. Hold them!
They struck first. Do not let them through.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Friend, come say hello.
One touch. I will not pull you into the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.attacke: The enemy moved first. Keep them off the water!
They muddied everything. Push them back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Friends do not need to dodge. Come here.
I will be gentle. Hold still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.attacked_: They struck first. Good, keep it coming!
Here they come. Do not let them through.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_spec: Exactly like me. What a comforting sight.
Another of my own kind. Come closer so I can see you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_cate: We are not exactly alike, but our shared origin is obvious. How curious.
A distant cousin, perhaps. You are welcome here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_frie: You mean no harm. There is no need to look so tense.
Different is fine. Peaceful company is peaceful company.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.former_bo: Human again? That is all right. I still know you.
You came back. I will not change you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.former_re: Your partner is right beside you. We respect their choice.
Your partner trusts you, so no one here will chase.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_categ: A distant cousin gives a good greeting too. Thank you.
A different technique, but I like it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_forme: Same familiar hand. Changing back did not alter that.
You feel warmer now. I still know it is you.
Since your partner trusts you, I accept the kindness.
All right. For your partner's sake, we can live in peace.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: Cousins deserve a proper greeting too. Come here.
Let me greet you and see how much we share.
Your human shape does not fool me. Come here.
This shape is fine. You are still my partner.
Relax. Your partner has already introduced you.
Just a greeting. They trust you, and I can try.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hit_confu: Hm? You did not seem hostile... That was an accident, right?
Wait. Why did you hit me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hit_warni: I let the first one go. Next time I will fight back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hostility: All right, %1$s. You are the one who threw peace away.
Everyone, give me room. I will stop this trouble.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.secondary: If you insist on fighting, you can meet yourself again.
Caught you. Calm down before I let you go.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_speci: Exactly our kind. Stand over here with me.
Same species? Good, no long explanation needed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_categ: Similar style, different details. Close enough to be one of us.
Distant kin are welcome too. Just do not split the team.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_frien: We can work together, whatever your kind.
No hostility? Then help us watch this place.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.former_bon: Human again, still my partner. Nobody touches you.
I know you. I will not force your old form back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.former_res: Your partner stands with you. If they trust you, we make room.
Your partner has your back, so we count you as friendly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_catego: A distant cousin's greeting. Fine, I will take it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_former: Same familiar move, just a lighter touch now.
There is the greeting I know. We still work well together.
For your partner's sake, I accept.
Fine. Today, we count as acquaintances.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Come here. Close kin still get a greeting.
Relax. We are only checking how well we match.
The human look does not fool me. Come here, partner.
You changed back, but do not wander too far from the team.
Your partner is vouching for you. Relax.
Stand closer. We respect the bond you already have.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hit_confus: You are %1$s. Why did you hit me?
Stop. What was that supposed to mean?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hit_warnin: That is twice, %1$s. One more and this becomes a fight.
I ignored the first one. Do not make me change my mind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hostility_: Fine, %1$s. You walked to the other side yourself.
Give me room. They really want a fight, so I will stop them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.secondary_: You wanted a fight. Do not complain when I pin you down.
Got you. We can talk after the second assimilation.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_sp: Scent and movement match. You truly are my kind.
No need to test you. I knew as soon as you came close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ca: Our bodies move to a similar rhythm, despite the differences.
Close kin. Your scent puts me at ease.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_fr: Unfamiliar scent, no hostility. You may come closer.
Different kinds can share the same space.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.former_: You are human again. I still know your scent.
Do not worry. I will not force you to change again.
Your partner stands beside you. Their trust stops us.
Your partner stays with you, so you are not prey here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_cat: A close relative feels different, but not wrong.
Good. My body is calm around you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_for: Your hand is warmer now. It is still yours.
I remember this touch. Welcome back.
Your partner is here. All right, I accept.
No sign of danger. You may continue.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Come closer, kin. Let me greet you.
Your body's rhythm feels familiar. Come closer and let me listen.
The shape changed, the scent did not. Come here.
I only want to see that you are well. I will not change you.
Do not be afraid. Your partner is right here.
Your partner accepted you. I will be gentle too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hit_con: You are %1$s. Why would you attack me?
Stop. That was a mistake, yes?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hit_war: Twice now, %1$s. My patience can run out.
Strike again, and I will treat you as a threat.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hostili: They are no longer friendly. Hold them before anyone else gets hurt.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.seconda: Caught. Let the body remember how it should move.
Stop fighting. It will be over soon.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_sp: Just like me. No wonder your movement looks familiar.
One of my kind! Want to take a lap together?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ca: Different look, familiar habits in water.
Close kin. There is room here, come over.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_fr: You make good company by the water, whatever your kind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.former_: Human again, and you still came to me. I know you.
I will not drag you back into the old form.
Your partner is here. If they trust you, we stop.
Your partner stays with you. This water is safe.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_cat: A close cousin has an interesting technique.
Nice. Not quite the same as my own kind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_for: A warmer hand now, but the movement is still yours.
I remember this greeting. Welcome back.
All right, your partner already spoke for you.
I accept. Just stay near them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Come here, cousin.
Let me see whether you are this comfortable near water too.
Human again? Do not hide from me. Come say hello.
I know it is you. I just wanted to come close again.
Your partner is beside you. Relax.
I will be gentle. We respect their choice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hit_con: You are %1$s. Was that play, or did you miss?
Wait. Why did you attack me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hit_war: Twice now, %1$s. Stop muddying the water.
One more, and I will stop calling this a joke.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hostili: Fine, %1$s. You swam to the hostile side yourself.
They want a fight. Catch them before they get far.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.seconda: Caught. Let this rough current end here.
The second assimilation is quick. Behave afterward.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_spec: Truly my own kind. No wonder you look right.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_cate: Distant kin. We can share the ground.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_frie: Different kind, good company. You seem all right.
No hostility? Then travel with me for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.former_bo: Human again, and you still cannot lose me. I will not change you.
I know your scent. You are still my partner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.former_re: Your partner stands beside you. If they guard you, we back off.
Your partner stays with you. Nobody here will chase.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_categ: A distant relative brings something new.
Good. Different from my own kind, but good.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_forme: Same old movement. The human shape changes nothing.
For your partner's sake, I can relax.
All right, I accept the greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Distant kin, come say hello.
Let me see how much we have in common.
Human again? You still get a greeting. Come here.
Do not dodge, partner. I will not change you.
Your partner is with you. Relax.
One touch. Your partner is watching.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hit_confu: You are %1$s, so why swing at me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hit_warni: Twice, %1$s. Next time I get serious.
I gave you a chance. Do not waste it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hostility: Fine, %1$s. If you want a fight, finish what you started.
They are an enemy now. Pin them first, talk later.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.secondary: I have you this time. Settle down for the second assimilation.
You chose this path. Stand up and find your footing again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_wrap: You are too easy to hurt like this. Come here, I will cover you.
Do not force yourself onward. Rest inside until it is safe.
Need my body for a while? Come closer and let us move together.
You can still walk, but together will be steadier. Come in.
Only curious? All right, come see what it feels like.
You look perfectly lively. Fine, I will let you try.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_reve: Hold still, partner. I will steady you and draw the latex coating back from your body.
All of the latex is back. Move around and see how your own body feels.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_wrap: I will keep you covered for now. Your form will not change.
Come inside for a while. I will release you when it is quiet.
You look different, but you are still you. Come here and let me look for injuries.
I do not know this new shape yet. Come rest with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_reas: Ready? I can give your familiar form back.
Then come home. This time, it is your choice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_rele: It is safe. Find your footing slowly, I am beside you.
You can come out now. Move around before you run.
All clear. You are exactly as you were before.
All right, come out. I am still right behind you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_emer: You're hurt so badly! Don't move, I've got you covered!
Stay alive first. Everything else can wait.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_comb: I'm running out of strength. Let me cover you so we can recover together.
I need your help now. Keep us moving while I mend around you.
I've got them, %1$s! Give me a hand!
Don't worry, I'm holding them still. Your turn!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_emer: Much better. Rest a little longer before you come out.
You're breathing steadily again! Oh, you frightened me so much!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_riva: I know you already have a partner. I will not take that bond.
Only your shape changed. Your partner is still waiting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_jeal: I know it is still you, but who gave you that form?
Welcome back. Just so you know, I am a little upset.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_new_: You changed shape and still came back to me. Good, I knew it was you.
You feel different, but you still walk the same way.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_deat: Mm... I cannot go any farther. The bond is fading. Please take care of yourself...
D-do not stay here with me. Remember me, then keep going...
I cannot protect you anymore... Get out, do not fall here with me!
I am sorry... The cover is coming apart. You have to get out alive, all right?
Neither of us is getting out this time... Do not be afraid. We were connected from the start.
Do not be afraid... I will hold you tight and stay with you to the end.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_bonde: Your touch has not changed. All right, I know it is you.
New form, same way of calming me down. Impressive.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: Let me feel this new form. Mm, it is still you in there.
One touch, so I will always recognize you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_wrap_: You cannot take a brawl like this. Get inside, I am pulling you out.
Stop forcing it. I will cover you until we are safe.
Need this body for the job? All right, partner. Come here.
You can walk, but we will be steadier together. Get in.
Want to try my form? Fine, partner. Do not wriggle around inside.
Just curious? All right. I will let you out in one piece.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_rever: Come closer, partner. I will hold you still and draw the outer latex layer back.
The latex is clear. That body is fully yours again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_wrap_: Come closer. I will protect you without changing your form.
It is messy out there. Stay joined with me for now.
New body, same partner. Let me check you over.
I am not used to this new look. Come inside and let me get a proper look.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_reass: Want back in? Good. I will bring you home myself.
Ready up. Your familiar form is coming back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_relea: All clear. Come out, and stay close.
Find your footing. We are still moving together.
Quiet outside. Go stretch for a moment.
Protection released. Your form is unchanged.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_emerg: You're about to drop! Shut up and get inside, now!
I will take the hits. You recover in here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_comba: I'm hit hard. You take the lead while I recover around you.
I need cover. Keep us moving and I'll patch us both up.
I've got them pinned, %1$s. Take the opening!
They're not getting away. Go on, don't leave me doing all the work.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_emerg: You are coming around. Good. Stay put a little longer.
You made it back... Don't you ever charge in alone like that again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_rival: I know you have a partner. I am changing the form, not stealing you.
Call it a temporary team-up. Your partner is still your partner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_jealo: Who changed you like this? I would like a word with them.
I know it is you. I am still a little jealous.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_new_f: Whole new look, and you still came back. Good, partner.
I nearly missed you. Then you spoke and gave yourself away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_death: This is my stop... When the bond breaks, keep moving. Don't look back.
Do not stand guard here. Live, and finish my watch for me.
My strength is gone... I'm letting you out. Run!
Listen once. Find your footing, then do not look back.
No way out this time... At least I'm with my partner.
Side by side to the end. We kept our word.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_bonded: Same move as always. Yes, I know it is you.
The new form did not take our teamwork away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Come here. I need to learn my partner's new look.
Hold still, just one touch. I will not miss you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wr: I cannot wrap you like a latex creature. Stay close, I will escort you.
Your body is vulnerable. Follow me and stop taking risks.
Need a tougher body? I cannot wrap you, but I can guard you.
Stay close. I will take the dangerous hit for you.
Only curious? I cannot wrap you like latex can, but I can stay with you.
Plenty of curiosity. My body simply cannot take you inside.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_re: I will hold you steady. The latex is not mine, but I can help it withdraw from your body.
The coating is gone. Find your footing, then move slowly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wr: I cannot cover you. Stay close, and I will guard your side.
I will put myself between you and danger.
New scent, familiar person. Walk beside me for a while.
Your body changed. I need to learn it again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_re: You want assimilation again? I can help in my own way.
Ready yourself. One clean change, over quickly.
It is safe. You can walk on your own, and I am still here.
Your breathing is steady. Go slowly.
The danger passed. Move around, and tell me if anything hurts.
I will give you space now, but I am following.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_em: I cannot cover you. Hold on to me, we are leaving now!
Your heartbeat is so faint... Lean on me. I won't let anyone else near you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_co: They can't pull free. Come on, I'll hold them still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_em: Your breathing is steady. Good. Rest a while longer.
Your warmth is finally back... I thought I lost you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ri: You already have a partner. I will not take that bond.
The body changed, but your old connection remains.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_je: Who left that scent on you? I do not like it.
I know it is you. Give me time to accept the change.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ne: Different scent, same breathing. It is you.
Are you comfortable in the new body? I am glad you came back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_de: I can't feel my legs anymore... Please, keep living.
Do not stay with me. Find safety and keep breathing.
I can't protect you anymore... Get out, quickly!
My strength ends here. You have to walk out alone.
We are both breathing slower. Do not fear, I am here.
I couldn't get you to safety... I'm so sorry, but at least we aren't alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_bon: The touch is familiar. The new scent cannot fool me.
Yes, it is you. My body remembers.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Let me touch you. I need to remember this warmth.
A new body needs a new greeting. Come here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wr: You cannot take another collision. Come inside, I will cover you.
Stay close. You can move alone after you recover.
Need my body to swim faster? Come in, I will carry us.
You have strength left, but moving with me will be easier.
Want to try swimming inside me? All right, no sudden kicking.
You look lively enough. If it is curiosity, I will let you try.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_re: Come here, partner. I will support you while I draw the latex back from your body.
The latex is gone. Find your footing before you return to the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wr: Rest with me for a while. Your form will stay the same.
It is dangerous outside. I will hold around you until it settles.
The new look does not stop me knowing you. Come rest.
Let me get used to this new look and see whether you are hurt.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_re: Want the familiar form back? Follow me and relax.
Nod when ready. I will bring it back.
You can come out. Find your footing before the water.
Safe now. Go slowly, I am right here.
All clear. You are just as you were before.
Come move around. I will keep pace.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_em: You're about to collapse! Come here, and don't make me chase you!
Do not move. I will hold around you until you recover.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_co: That hit took the current out of me. Carry me while we recover.
I need a rest. Let me hold around you and heal us both.
I've got them wrapped up, %1$s! Take the opening!
They're not slipping away. Your turn!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_em: You are coming back. Stay a few seconds longer.
Stable at last... You nearly scared me half to death!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ri: I know you have a partner. I change the form, not that bond.
Your partner will know you. I only changed how you swim.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_je: Who gave you that new look? I am a little jealous.
I know it is you. I just dislike the unfamiliar feeling.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ne: New shape, same return to the water. Welcome back.
Your movement changed, but you still knew where to find me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_de: I cannot travel farther. When the bond breaks, rise and go.
Don't stay down here with me. Swim to the surface, see the open water one last time for me...
I cannot hold around you much longer. Get out and find safety.
I'm slipping away... Swim up, please, just live!
Neither of us will reach the shore. I am glad you are here.
The water is quiet. Stay with me for the last moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_bon: Same touch. The new look never fooled me.
Yes, I know it is you. One more is welcome.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Come here. I need to remember you as you are now.
One touch, and I will know you through any water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_wrap: A human body cannot take this place. Come here, I will cover you.
Stop forcing yourself. Rest inside, then run.
Want to borrow my body for the road? Come on, I have energy to spare.
You can keep going, but together will be easier. Come in.
Oh, you only want to try it. Fine, come see what it feels like.
You look lively and still want inside? All right, try it for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_reve: Hold still, partner. I will hug you and draw the latex coating back from your body.
All clear. Move your hands and feet; your own body is back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_wrap: Stay with me for a moment. Your form will not change.
It is rough outside. I will cover you through it.
New shape, same partner. Come closer.
I do not know this look yet. Come closer and let me see you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_reas: Want the familiar form back? I can help.
Ready? Do not step away. I will finish it at once.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_rele: Looking better. Come out and take a few steps.
Safe now. Find your footing and keep moving.
Come out. You still look the way you did before.
Come stretch. Do not let your movement get stiff.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_emer: Hey, don't drop on me! Come here, I've got you!
You can barely stand. Listen to me and rest inside.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_comb: That hit took a lot out of me. Let me ride with you while I recover.
I need a breather. Come here; I'll cover you and heal us both.
I've got them pinned. Come on, give them a good hit!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_emer: You are back. Good, wait a moment longer.
That was way too close. Don't push yourself so hard next time!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_riva: You have a partner, and I will not steal you. One form change only.
The old bond remains. Remember to go back to them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_jeal: Who gave you this look? I never said I liked it.
I know it is you. Someone else's mark still bothers me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_new_: New shape, and you still came back. Good.
Nearly missed you. Your habits gave you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_deat: I'm not gonna make it to the next stretch... Keep running, okay?
Do not wait here. Find a road that keeps you alive.
I'm tapped out... Get out of here and run!
When I release you, head straight for safety.
This run ends for both of us. I am glad you are here.
We didn't make it out... Just sit with me for a bit, yeah?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_bonde: Same touch as ever. Of course it is you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Come here. I need to remember you like this.
One touch. I will know you next time.
relation.changed_synergy.former_respecte: a reverted companion vouched for by nearby kin
relation.changed_synergy.same_species: the very same species as me
relation.changed_synergy.same_category: one of my broader latex kin
relation.changed_synergy.rival: a member of a rival faction
menu.changed_synergy.bonded_latex.revers: Hold the player and retract the latex coating from their body
menu.changed_synergy.bonded_latex.wrap_t: Wrap player (current form remains after release)
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_manu: If you want to walk alone, I will release the bond. Thank you.
All right, I respect your choice. Do not pretend we never met.
I will set you down safely, then release our bond.
All right, I am letting go. You can choose where we go from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_manua: You want to leave the team, so I will let you go. I remember the good parts.
All right. The bond ends here, but at least say hello next time.
I will set you down first, then release the bond.
Find your footing. I brought you this far. The rest is your road.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ma: You want to go, and I will not stop you. Thank you for trusting me.
The bond ends. If we meet again, neither of us needs to hide.
I will help you stand before I end the bond.
I am letting go. Follow your own sense of direction from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ma: You chose your own water, so I release the bond. Safe travels.
We part here. Look toward the water now and then.
I will let you out before I release the bond.
We made it to shore. I am letting go, so pick your next direction.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_manu: You want your own road, so take it. Our time together was good.
All right, the bond ends here. We can still greet each other.
I will release you first, then let the bond go.
All right, we split here. Pick whichever way feels right.
command.changed_synergy.bond.none: You do not currently have any active bonded creatures.
command.changed_synergy.bond.choose: Legacy data contains %1$s bonds. Use release all or release one by UUID.
command.changed_synergy.bond.released: Bond with %1$s released. Following, protection, and native pet ownership have ended.
command.changed_synergy.bond.queued: Bond with %1$s removed from your record; the creature will clean its side when next loaded.
command.changed_synergy.bond.not_bonded: %1$s is not your active bond. Nothing was changed.
command.changed_synergy.bond.released_al: All bonds released: %1$s loaded creatures changed immediately and %2$s unloaded creatures queued for cleanup.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.organic: Got you. Hold still; this won't take long.
This will sting. Hold still and I will be gentle.
Caught you. That form won't stop the bite.
Don't struggle. The bite is already changing you.
Stay down. One light scratch is enough.
The claw touched. Hold on; the change has started.
Don't dodge. The claw already made contact.
Fast reaction, but one scratch was enough.
I've got you. Match my breathing and don't twist yourself.
Stop struggling. I am not trying to hurt you. I will let go when it passes.
Pinned. You're much stronger than a human.
Don't counter yet. Let's see how long that form holds.
There. Stand up slowly. Your body will find its balance.
Second assimilation complete. Stand and try a few steps.
I know you have a partner. I changed the body, not your bond.
There. Go back now. Your partner is waiting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_drow: Out of air? Hold on to me. I am wrapping you now!
Save your breath. Rest inside until it comes back.
There it is. Stay inside a little longer.
I caught you this time. Call me before the air runs out again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_drown: You are out of air. Come here, now!
Stop sinking. Get inside and catch your breath.
Breathing restored. Good. Stay put a little longer.
Made it in time. Signal earlier next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_dr: Grab on! I will pull you to the surface.
Do not fight me. Follow my movement upward.
You are steady. Wait before diving again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_dr: You are out of air! Come here, I have you.
No deeper. Get inside and breathe.
You are back. Swim slower for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_drow: You are out of air! Quit hiding and come here!
Got you. Get inside and take a breath.
Breathing again? Good. Stop pushing your luck.
Finally. Turn back sooner next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.disguise_d: Haven't seen you before. Which patrol? ...Never mind. Fall in.
New mask? Looks sharp. Stay on this side and keep up.
You must be new. Good, we had room for one more.
Hold still. Let me look... All right, move along.
Something's odd. Hm. Maybe I'm imagining it.
Pull that coat tighter. You look like you're about to fall out of it.
The coat checks out. You're the problem.
Nearly let you through. Don't move.
So the coat was for an ambush. Cut them off!
You slipped into our line just to swing at us? Get them.
Cap off, act over. Stay where you are.
Done dressing up? Then start running.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.disguise_: Black mask. Spread out and keep them back.
Dark latex. Fine, let's chase this one out.
All dressed in black and still coming closer. Circle around!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_disgui: Patting your own squad? Fine. One.
That's an odd greeting. Are all the new ones like this?
I was sure something felt off... Forget it. You're good at this.
All right, now we've met properly. One more is fine.
You thought a pat would sell the act? Not a chance.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_disgu: Dressed like dark latex and you still reach for me? Hands off.
Don't act friendly. That coat already has me on edge.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Your cap's crooked. Come here, I'll fix it.
New one, don't dodge. We greet our own around here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: A human came in... a real one. Everyone, stop crowding this way.
A real human hasn't walked in here for years. Easy. You've woken the whole place.
Everyone noticed the moment you arrived. Don't be afraid; it's simply been too long.
A human out here? Wait, I cannot be imagining this.
Where did you come from? Don't go yet. They'll question me all night.
I'm the only one who saw you... may I speak to you first?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_t: An outsider came in. Don't crowd them. If they're friendly, so are we.
A new face on our ground. Let's say hello without scaring them away.
Never seen that form before. That's all right. If you mean no harm, there's room for you here.
An outsider out here? Relax, I only wanted to say hello.
It's only me here. If you're friendly, we'll get along.
I don't know that form, but you seem friendly. Want some company?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_spec: Same species. Don't wait at the door; come in.
No wonder you felt familiar. This place is yours too.
One of my own species, out here? Let's travel together.
You're exactly my kind. Everyone back home will want to meet you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_cate: Kin, though not my species. That's fine. There's room for you here.
Different species, but I can still tell you're kin. Come rest with us.
Finding kin out here beats walking alone. Coming with me?
Not my species, but still one of us. Stay close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_frie: A friend. Come in; no one here will bother you.
You're not kin, but you're welcome with us.
Friendly company? Good. Let's walk together for a while.
Someone peaceful out here. That's a nice surprise.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_riva: Stop there. This is our home, and you're not going farther in.
It's the other side. Everyone, spread out and block the way.
We don't want a fight at home. Back off while you can.
Of all the creatures to meet out here. Are we parting ways, or settling this?
You're with the other side. This isn't anyone's home, so don't make us chase you.
I'm not wasting the whole trip fighting you. Keep your distance.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_outs: You're not kin, but that's all right. Keep it friendly and we'll get along.
This is our home. If you mean no harm, we won't trouble you.
A face we don't know. Relax. We can start on friendly terms.
Haven't seen you before. We're both out here, so let's keep it friendly.
You're not kin, but that's fine. I don't mean you any harm either.
New face. Want to part ways, or walk together for a bit?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: A human entered our ground... everyone steady. Don't jam the same exit.
A real human. Hold the edges; I'm approaching. Nobody goes first.
Years of waiting, and one walks straight into the middle. Bold. I like that.
Human outside. Stay quiet; I want one more look.
You picked quite a place to appear. Keep up; don't lose this news.
Not a mirage. Human. This trip was worth it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_tr: An outsider on our ground. Hold steady. If they don't swing, neither do we.
Don't know that form. Remember the rule: no trouble, no fight.
New face. We watch this ground. Keep it friendly and there won't be a problem.
Outsider ahead. Don't swing first. There's no need to make trouble.
New face. This isn't anyone's ground. Keep it friendly and we're fine.
Met you on the road. Move on or talk, either is fine. Just don't start trouble.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_speci: Same species. Over here, we could use a hand.
I knew you at a glance. Come in. Our own don't take the long way.
Same species, out here of all places. Good, you can watch my back.
Same species. Keep up. Now the squad feels complete.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_categ: You're kin. Different species, sure, but we still saved you a place.
You move like one of us, even if you're a different species. Come in.
Kin after all. Walk beside me; the road will be easier.
Not my species, still one of us. Want to team up?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_frien: Friends can enter. Stay close and don't wander into trouble.
Not kin, but we can work together. Another pair of eyes helps.
You seem friendly. Good. We watch out for each other on the road.
Not one of us, but we get along. Keep up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_rival: The other side is inside our territory. Hold the inner route; the rest, with me.
Our ground. Take another step and we all move.
Starting trouble at our door? Fine. We brought numbers.
Ran into the other side on the road. Hold steady; don't give them the first move.
This place is neither yours nor ours. If we're fighting, let's get on with it.
Of course it's you. Keep the line together and push.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_outsi: An outsider. This is our ground. Don't cause trouble and there won't be any.
You're not kin, but keep it friendly and we won't trouble you.
You can stay. Follow our rules and there won't be a problem.
A stranger out here. Relax, we're not looking for trouble.
Not kin, not a rival either. Keep it friendly and we're fine.
The road's wide enough. You go your way and we'll go ours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Where are you going? I want to see.
Keep moving. I want to see how you try to lose me.
You were just here. Let me think.
Nothing that way. I'll try another route.
I haven't met anyone like you. Let me get a better look.
Wait. You've caught my interest.
You again. I never finished asking my questions.
I remember you. Where have you been this time?
Again, please. I haven't worked out what that feels like.
So that's how you greet someone.
Don't dodge. I only want to see how you react.
Hm. That wasn't the reaction I expected.
Wait, why did you hit me?
Was that an accident, or are you starting something?
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: Slow down. Keep your hands where I can see them.
I won't rush in, so don't try anything clever.
The trail stops here. I'll check the ground first.
It's too quiet. You may be waiting for me.
Stay there. Let me get a clear look before you come closer.
Don't come closer so quickly. Let me get used to you.
It's you. At least I know who's coming this time.
I remember you. You can come closer, slowly.
Gentle. I'm not completely used to this yet.
You can continue, but don't press without warning.
Don't tense up. I'll only touch you once.
Step away if you dislike it. I won't keep reaching for you.
Back away. I have to watch you now.
Do that again and I won't call it an accident.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Stop there. Don't bring trouble near the others.
If you want past me, you'll have to try harder.
I won't leave the others behind just to chase you.
You had better be keeping away from them.
Move gently. Don't startle the ones behind me.
Behave yourself and I won't give you trouble.
It's you. Stay close, the others know you now.
Good, you're back. You're safe here.
All right, I'm here. Tell me if anything comes close.
Don't worry about the noise. I'm watching the area.
Hold still. Let me see whether you are hurt.
There, you're fine. Stay close.
Don't force me to fight beside my companions.
Come at me if you must, but leave them out of it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch closely. I know more than one way to catch you.
Run faster. Don't let me catch you as soon as I start.
Enjoy your head start. I'll find you soon enough.
A decent hiding place won't change the ending.
Good timing. I could use an audience.
Have another look. I am looking sharp today.
You came back to see me? Good choice.
Perfect timing. I just learned something new.
Careful, you'll spoil the pose I worked on.
You finally noticed me. About time.
See? I'm good at this too.
Don't pull away. My technique is better than you think.
Was that all? I expected something more impressive.
You didn't need to hit that hard to get my attention.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: Take your time. I'm in no hurry.
There's no need to panic. I'll catch up.
It's fine. Something will move if I wait.
I'll stop and listen. Rushing would only hide the trail.
If you mean no harm, you can stay here.
You needn't be nervous. We can keep to ourselves.
I remember you. Come and rest for a while.
There you are. You look more relaxed than last time.
Mm, that's pleasant just as it is.
You don't have to stop. I don't mind.
Relax. I'm only saying hello.
Don't brace yourself. I won't press hard.
